title: ARTIFICIAL AFTER ALL
author: Han Saglam
facts: 32 input numbers (latent) and 4 convolution layers; one network in each of 256 contracts
each contract's own bytecode; int8, Huffman-compressed
description: This work is 256 contracts on Ethereum. Each contract holds one seed and one compressed neural network in its own code. A call to the contract runs the network inside Ethereum and returns a 32×32 grayscale image of 1,024 bytes. The contract computes the image during the call and stores no image. The address on this page is one of the 256 contracts. Another contract, called a factory, created all 256.

call.note: artificial() runs the network and returns a 32×32 image as 1,024 pixel bytes. The raw result has 1,088 bytes, because the Ethereum result format adds 64 bytes before the pixels.
